# toggle-chip

## Passthrough: `ref` is the chip, not its label

A toggle chip IS a `Badge`, so `ref` and everything else you spread land where
Badge's do — the chip shell (a `<button>` by default), never the `truncate` span
inside it. `ref` is newly typed; it was already flowing untyped through the old
anonymous index signature. See
[the passthrough contract](../../../passthrough/CLAUDE.md).

## Plugin reference

- Description: Toggle-chip control: a stateful pill (composes Badge) in one of three colour treatments — solid (filled when on), ghost (accent fill when on, transparent when off) and tinted (accent wash when on, bordered when off) — with active state, button-height matching, polymorphic `as`, plus a SegmentedControl single-select group helper.
